title: Observation: records
description: A page of one table; each record validates against ledger_row, invoice, payment or fx_row by `table`. next_cursor is null on the last page. `limit_clamped: true` appears only when a limit above 50 was cut to 50.

limit_clamped.description: Present (true) only when the request's limit was above the page size (50) and was cut to it.
